$Comment: The Merrymaker: the season's capstone, earned the moment every achievement tagged merry in the
Seasons > Christmas subcategory is earned in the same year: the Christmas Ornament, Present Hunter,
Gift Giver, Carol Singer and Christmas Decorator. MetaSelector picks them, so a new merry achievement
counts toward it with no edit here; it never picks itself or another capstone. Secret Santa, Snowball
Fight and the Yeti stay out on purpose, so nobody needs other players or a boss fight for it. It
inherits the yearly occurrence, so each year has its own copy, and it pays the title
Christmas_Merrymaker through the Title reward kind, on unlock. Keep the merry tag off this file.
Each year's copy also pays Christmas Coins to spend at the Christmas stalls, and offers MMO Skill
Tree's Mmo_Boost_Token: half again as much XP in every skill for an hour, which the player starts when
it suits them. Both wait in Rewards.Claim on the achievements page, and the collect notice lists them.
The token row's own Requires, the hytale:mod_installed gate, leaves it out on a server without that
mod, unpaid and unshown, and the coins still pay. The _Christmas folder makes the id
